verdict.rationale: Qodo documents deploying entirely within your own infrastructure, with single-tenant, on-premises, and air-gapped models (qodo-docs-16, qodo-docs-40, qodo-docs-45). This lets a customer decide where their data physically lives. However, the evidence never mentions choosing a region or data-residency location for the hosted multi-tenant service, so residency control appears to require taking on self-hosting. Missing for 10: region/residency selection for the hosted SaaS, explicit data-residency documentation (e.g., EU/US regions), and independent corroboration.
